notes.title: Full Release 1.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Follow the mayors tasks to complete the story[/p][/*][*][p]New Clock to fast forward the slow days[/p][/*][*][p]Workers are now a once off payment[/p][/*][*][p]Some tutorial adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p]\[Bug Fixes][/p][list][*][p]Opening a decor box broke interaction displays[/p][/*][*][p]Effects volume could not be adjusted in settings[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Feature Update 0.954 : Space Breach
notes.content: [list][*][p]Space Breach playable arcade now in store[/p][/*][*][p]Shelving can now be found in the new Decor section[/p][/*][*][p]Toms shop removal in favor of free 24/7 delivery[/p][/*][*][p]Food Stall for passive income can be found outside the store[/p][/*][*][p]Food Stall can be upgraded via the computer for increased income[/p][/*][*][p]Price adjustments to prizebox unlocks and Decor items[/p][/*][*][p]Collect all interaction is now available from the start[/p][/*][*][p]Rent updated to per expansion as per requests[/p][/*][*][p]Sliding staff only door for your convenience[/p][/*][/list][p]\[Bug Fixes][/p][p]Next day crash error when closing stat menu[/p][p]As we near the 1.0 Full Release , feel free to give your feedback on what features you would like to see on release day.[/p]

notes.title: Feature Update : custom store name and fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customize your store name.
[*] Store doors now open/close.
[*] Store can be closed at any time.
[*] Rent can be paid before the end of a day.
[*] Phone now only rings once.
[*] No delay between prize pinning from box.
[*] Customer spawn rate tweak at low levels.
[*] ESC now closes shop window.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*] Tutorial stuck at claw machine fixed.
[*] Tutorial "Add another box" has to be completed to order.
[*] Sun Position offset position fix.
[/list]

notes.title: Feature update 0.897
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
The Coin Bag upgrade price has been lowered and can be unlocked at level 1.
Some tutorial improvements.
Coin amount for declining customers is shown with token amount in UI.

notes.title: Feature update & Fixes 0.895
notes.content:
[Improvements]
Customers can now be declined
Auto door open / close
Customer amount will ramp up slowly from level 0 to 2

[Bug Fixes]
Boxes will now drop at your feet when empty.
Landlord Day 3 rent text fixed.

notes.title: Feature update 0.89!
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customers will now first request items visible in store when available.
[*] Tutorial now includes Tom's Shop and stacking boxes / prizes.
[*] Tom's Shop now has Tags displayed on each box.
[/list]
[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*] Tom's shop floating prizes no longer display "pickup" 
[*] Machines in cart resets correctly to zero each day
[*] Removed pickup option for prizes while holding a box.
[/list]

I will continue to provide updates with the help of the community.

notes.title: Arcade Boss Simulator is Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1][b]What’s Included:[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] -Organise your store the way you want. 
[*] -New prize collections to display in your store or reward your customers with.
[*] -Add in fun decor to your store from a selection of neon signs and lights.
[*] -Place in the new Prize Zone machine to serve the majority of your customers with what they want.
[*] -Store Expansions.
[/olist]

- Free demo available!
